title: NAS security mode control completion by the network

entities.name: NAS security mode control completion
entities.description: Procedure where the AMF processes the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message to complete NAS security activation and handle contained NAS messages.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to confirm successful NAS security mode activation.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: IE that can contain other NAS messages like REGISTRATION REQUEST, SERVICE REQUEST, or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for registration procedure, can be contained in NAS message container.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for service request procedure, can be contained in NAS message container.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for control plane service request procedure, can be contained in NAS message container.

entities.name: 5GMM capability
entities.description: IE indicating UE capabilities including S1 mode support.

entities.name: T3560
entities.description: Timer used during NAS security mode control procedure, stopped upon SECURITY MODE COMPLETE receipt.

entities.name: Security activation
entities.description: AMF shall integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages with selected 5GS integrity and ciphering algorithms after SECURITY MODE COMPLETE.

entities.name: S1 mode supported condition
entities.description: Condition where 5GMM capability IE indicates S1 mode supported and AMF supports N26 interface.

relations.description: NAS security mode control completion procedure is triggered by receipt of SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
AMF stops timer T3560 upon receipt of SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
Procedure establishes that AMF shall integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages after SECURITY MODE COMPLETE.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message may contain NAS message container IE.
NAS message container IE can contain REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
NAS message container IE can contain SERVICE REQUEST message.
NAS message container IE can contain CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GMM capability IE.
5GMM capability IE guards condition for S1 mode support.
Condition triggers initiation of another NAS security mode control procedure when S1 mode is supported and AMF supports N26 interface.
